title: Micro-journal: SOC2 task list and day notes
content:
Quick micro-journal for the day — scattershot notes, errands, and tiny brainstorms about SOC2 evidence that I need to not lose. Mostly a private scratch list; will tidy later if anything needs to be shared.

Morning summary:
- Woke up with an action list after 1:1 with Priya: finish vendor access matrix, collect rotation logs, and confirm SSO test plan.
- Calendar: evidence sync 11:30 with Eli + infra, intake call 15:00 with vendor AcmeKey (KMS), optional rollout demo 16:30.

Top priorities (today):
1) Vendor review: AcmeKey (KMS-as-a-service) — deliverables by EOD:
   - Confirm contract clause: no shared keys, HSM/TLS details (ask legal to pull section 4.2).
   - Evidence item: request attestation PDF and architecture diagram (ask vendor for one-page topologies).
   - Jira: SEC-4321 assigned to Eli for contract review; follow-up: add PR checklist item for new vendor onboarding.
2) SOC2 control evidence (CC6 / change management):
   - Pull list of merged PRs in last 3 months that touched infra config (GH-PR-4120 gives sample).
   - Export deploy timeline for prod via CI: last 90 days (jenkins/gcb query).
   - Create a tiny matrix: PR -> reviewer -> approval timestamp -> deployment tag.
3) IAM log artifact for CC7:
   - Query cloud audit logs for admin role changes between 2026-01-01 and 2026-05-01.
   - Save CSV, name: iam-audit-jan-may-2026.csv, store in Evidence bucket with lifecycle note.

Side tasks (low effort):
- Draft note to infra about scheduled key rotation doc (2 bullets).
- Add short blurb to onboarding checklist about vendor phone escalation.
- Quick check: ensure SSO SAML metadata file exists in repo; if missing add ticket.

Blockers / questions:
- Legal hasn't returned redlines for AcmeKey; need ETA. Slack thread started but thread response stalled.
- Need confirmation from infra whether we have logs retained for 400 days — if not, escalate to Priya for retention policy exception.
- Is there a consolidated naming convention for evidence files? (I prefer prefix: evidence_<control>_<artifact>_<date>.csv) — open to feedback.

Notes to self / commands to run:
- gcloud logging read \"protoPayload.methodName:('SetIamPolicy' OR 'SetCredential')\" --project=redwood-prod --start-time="2026-01-01T00:00:00Z" --end-time="2026-05-01T23:59:59Z" --format=csv > ~/evidence/iam-audit-jan-may-2026.csv
- GH query: repo:infra is:merged merged:>=2026-02-01 author:!bot label:deploy

Meeting scraps (11:30 evidence sync):
- Eli: will take PR -> deployment matrix template (he already has an example).
- Infra (June): suggested we keep 1-year hot logs but 2-year cold storage — ask ops about retrieval times.
- Action: assign someone to verify KMS key usage policies for service-accounts-only.

Vendor call (15:00 AcmeKey) prep checklist:
- Ask for SOC2/ISO attestation copies, HSM provider name, cert chain.
- Confirm BYOK support and import process (we prefer customer-held keys).
- Validate network access model: public API vs private peering, firewall rules, IP ranges.
- Ask for sample SLA and incident report template.

Tiny rough timeline (today -> Friday):
- Today (05/15): gather attestation + IAM logs export + draft change-management matrix.
- Thu (05/16): review vendor contract redlines (legal) + upload artifacts to evidence bucket + quick run of acceptance test for SSO.
- Fri (05/17): finalize packet for SOC2 auditors (rough), sync with Priya for sign-off.

Random thoughts (brain dump):
- Could we template a single vendor evidence intake form? One page that maps to control families and lists required artifacts + expected response time. Saves repeated asks.
- Maybe add a tiny script to standardize evidence filenames and upload to GCS with metadata (control, owner, date) — low-hanging automation.

Items to move to tracked tickets (TODO):
- Create ticket: vendor-evidence-intake-form (assign to me).
- Create ticket: evidence-filename-normalizer script (assign to infra-dev).
- Create ticket: iaudit-retention-check (assign to SRE).

End-of-day checklist (quick):
- [ ] Attestation requested from AcmeKey (email + Slack confirmation).
- [ ] IAM log CSV exported and uploaded.
- [ ] PR -> deploy matrix started (stub saved).
- [ ] Add evidence file naming preference note to team doc.

Small personal note: keep tonight free for a digest of the week. If Priya signs off on the retention ask I can close two tickets next sprint.

---
If anything looks like it should be promoted into a shared doc, move it under shared_drives/security-and-compliance and ping @compliance in Slack. For now this is a private working list.
